input.request: I need a copy of the bank record for my £74.00 payment to a repair contractor, so I can share evidence of the payment with them. I can see the transaction in my secure portal, but need a document showing its current stage.

events.text: I show an outgoing payment of £74.00 dated 14 July 2025 in your transaction history. Its reference is HV-040 and its bank status is SENT.

I need a record for this particular payment to give my repair contractor. I can see HV-040 in my history, but I need a document showing its stage; I understand that the contractor’s confirmation of receipt is separate.
I matched the customer’s request to payment HV-040 in the authenticated secure-portal session. Please generate the payment record for this operation for delivery to the customer’s secure portal.

summary: Mara Ellison asked through secure chat for a document showing the stage of her £74.00 payment, reference HV-040, to give to her repair contractor. The desk classed it as a document question, found the documents system had already been asked, and closed the case as waiting because no answer has come back. A second request to the documents system was refused because the rules only allow it while the case is triaged. Nothing has been sent to Mara, she is still marked unverified, and the record does not say whether a document is ready, so the case is waiting on the documents system's reply.

request_type.instructions: What does the customer want from the bank now?

criteria.question: something the bank's records can answer (a status, a reason, a detail, a statement, a report), even if the customer may want something changed afterwards
criteria.register: a dispute, a review, a return, or the correction of a record that is wrong, for a team to look into
criteria.change: a change the customer chooses to an instruction, a mandate or the profile (a new amount, date, phone or address)
criteria.instruction: an instruction to act now (block a card, cancel a payment or a mandate, revoke a role)
criteria.access: signing in, a PIN, a password, recovery of access
criteria.authority: something only another person may approve or give (a second signatory, an administrator, a new user's access)
criteria.unknown: The text does not say, or says too little to tell.

criteria.transfer: an outgoing transfer or payment the customer made, or a payment instruction
criteria.incoming_payment: money expected into the customer's account, or a refund to it
criteria.standing_order: a standing order or a recurring payment instruction
criteria.direct_debit: a Direct Debit mandate or collection
criteria.card: a card itself (replacement, dispatch, block, restriction, PIN)
criteria.card_payment: a card purchase or card payment attempt
criteria.batch: an uploaded payment or payroll file, or a row in it
criteria.payment_package: a payment package waiting for signatories
criteria.profile: the customer's profile details (name, phone, address)
criteria.access: signing in, devices, sessions, password recovery
criteria.document: an export, a report or a bank confirmation document
criteria.fee: a fee or charge applied by the bank
criteria.role: a user's role or access in a company profile
criteria.unknown: The text does not say, or says too little to tell.

content.text:
I've stopped here, and the case is waiting. The documents system has already been asked about this request, but nothing has come back, so I can't send Mara a payment record yet.

The desk refused a second request to the documents system. Its rules only allow that request when the case is triaged, and this case is in the waiting state. Mara is also still marked as unverified, and the case doesn't say whether a document is ready.

I haven't promised her a document. Once the documents system answers, the next step is to reply with what it says about HV-040. That should be a record of the £74.00 payment with bank status SENT. It will not confirm that the contractor received the money.
